Answer: C
Reason: On the frontal chest radiograph (Figure 1a), the right-sided nodule obscures the right heart border, which is the silhouette sign indicating a lesion in the right middle lobe (anterior). The left-sided nodule is visible through the cardiac shadow, meaning it does not obscure the left heart border; this "loss of the silhouette" or visibility against the dense heart implies a posterior location, such as in the lower lobe (retrocardiac).
